<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex026012026-11-0601-58-02" status="reviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3807">bla ma dag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">byang yes</rs></note> na re de ni ma yin te <note type="gloss">de dang de</note> chos nyid dbye' ba med pa tsam gyis sans rgyas su 'dzin na | log shes su 'gro zhing <note type="gloss">yang</note> 'jig tshogs la lta bas gnas pa'i chos nyid dang | sangs
				<lb edRef="inst:4652" n="108b7"/> rgyas kyi chos nyid la yang dbye ba med pas so so skye bo la yang der 'dzin par thal lo ||
				 des na mdo' dang bstun na sangs rgyas thob pa'i bbegs sgrib pa tshan po che spangs pa dang | sangs rgyas kyi rgyu khyad par can la gnas pas sangs rgyas thob pa dang 'dra bas sangs rgyas su 'dzin pa zhes kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brten nas 'dzin pa <expan>yin no</expan> || </seg></TEI>
